description.value:
You send out a pulse of magic that detects the presence of technology, including creatures, hazards, and objects with the tech trait. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of technology. You can choose to ignore technology you're fully aware of, such as the technology of you and your allies and the ship you're traveling in.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the level or rank of the most powerful technology, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level or highest-ranked technology. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
